setup.name: Setup doctor
setup.title: Setup doctor
setup.lead: Is everything the agent and your stack need installed? The doctor only looks: it starts each tool once to read its version, sends nothing and changes nothing.
setup.summary.blocking: {count, plural, one {# thing to fix} other {# things to fix}}
setup.summary.optional: {count, plural, one {# optional tool missing} other {# optional tools missing}}
setup.reason.tooOld: Version {version} is too old: the agent needs Node 24 or newer
setup.reason.noVersion: Found, but it did not tell its version
setup.reason.noAdb: The SDK is there, but adb (Platform-Tools) is missing
setup.reason.notConfigured: ANDROID_HOME is not set to an existing SDK folder
setup.reason.unknown: The agent's state is not known yet
setup.reason.claudeOff: Claude is switched off in Settings > Providers
setup.reason.sdk_incompatible: Another version than this app needs
setup.reason.sdk_unverified: Its files do not match the expected list
setup.reason.sdk_broken: Installed but it does not load
setup.reason.sdkFirst: Checked once the Agent SDK works
setup.reason.needsConfirm: The command line needs your confirmation
setup.reason.offline: Claude cannot be reached right now
setup.why.node: The agent runs on Node.js 24 or newer; so do most JavaScript projects.
setup.why.sdk: The agent itself. It is installed once, outside the app, from the official package.
setup.why.login: Agent runs use your Claude Code sign-in (a subscription or an API key).
setup.why.git: Changes, commits and branches all go through Git.
setup.why.gh: Pull requests and CI status in the app; not needed to code.
setup.why.xcode: Building and running iOS apps, and the compilers many tools need on a Mac.
setup.why.cocoapods: Installs the native iOS dependencies of React Native and many iOS projects.
setup.why.android: Building and running Android apps; adb talks to a phone or an emulator.
setup.why.watchman: Makes Metro and Jest notice file changes faster in big React Native projects.
setup.how.node: Install Node.js 24 or newer from nodejs.org.
setup.how.sdk: Open Settings > Providers > Claude: it shows the two commands that install it.
setup.how.login: Open Settings > Providers > Claude and check its state.
setup.how.xcode: Install Xcode from the App Store, then open it once.
setup.how.android: Install Android Studio and, in its SDK Manager, the Android SDK and Platform-Tools.
setup.terminalTip: Opens a terminal tab with the command typed in. It runs only when you press Return there.
setup.typed: The command is in the terminal
setup.typedBody: Read it, then press Return to run it.
setup.typeFailed: The command could not be typed into a terminal
setup.foot: Commands are for macOS with Homebrew. On Windows only Node.js, Git and gh are checked; the Apple and Android tools say Not checked.
setup.card.sdk: The agent cannot start yet: the Claude Agent SDK is not ready.
setup.card.login: The agent cannot start yet: sign in to Claude Code first.
setup.card.cli: The agent cannot start yet: Claude Code is not installed or its last check failed.
setup.section.name: Setup doctor
setup.section.title: Setup doctor
setup.section.desc: Checks Node.js, the Agent SDK, the Claude Code login, Git and the iOS and Android tools, with a fix for each.
setup.section.enableDesc: Adds the panel, its command and a card in the New Run dialog while the agent cannot start.
